text:
Alex: Heads-up — opened #8423, migration guide + SDK snippet update. touches python/ts examples and the migration doc. needs a docs reviewer and someone to sanity-check the snippet outputs before preview.
Priya: @Alex linking the PR? I can take a quick pass but I'm swamped until 3pm PT.
Alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8423 — the preview currently failed linkcheck and the python snippet test.
docs-bot: Preview build failed for PR #8423: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/8423
docs-bot: Failing job: docs/link-check, logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/7789
Ben: I can look at linkcheck after lunch. ping me if it's just a bad relative link.
Sophie: I can do the SDK snippet verification (run the quick example locally) — what env do you need, @Alex?
Alex: @Sophie just Python 3.11 and the latest sdk from main. The snippet error is in the env var name change — old example uses REDWOOD_API_KEY vs NEW_REDWOOD_KEY.
Priya: if it's a naming mismatch I can fix the snippet in the doc and push a follow-up in this PR unless someone else already editing.
Alex: I already pushed a commit that renames the var in the migration guide, but missed the generated snippet in examples/python/quickstart.md — that's what's causing the test to fail.
Sophie: copying the failing output below — local run replicates test failure:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/snippet_runner.py", line 42, in <module>
    client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
KeyError: 'REDWOOD_API_KEY'
```
Nadia: Quick suggestion — instead of renaming env var everywhere in one PR, could we alias in code samples and add a short note? less churn across snippets.
Ben: +1 to alias approach. It keeps previews stable and avoids a chain of PRs. We can add a one-line note: "You can set REDWOOD_API_KEY or NEW_REDWOOD_KEY (both supported)" and update SDK examples to prefer NEW_REDWOOD_KEY.
Alex: Sounds good. @Priya do you want to update the snippet, or should I open a tiny follow-up?
Priya: I can push a small commit to this branch to fix the example and update the test harness to check both env names. Will do in ~30m.
Sophie: After that I can re-run the snippet tests and sanity-check the output, then re-request review.
Ben: Also — who is on reviewer rotation this week? The PR touches migration guide and SDK examples; ideally one from docs + one from SDK. @Nadia do you know current rotation?
Nadia: Docs rota: Priya (this week), Alex (backup). SDK reviewers: Sophie then Ben then Marco. So we need Priya + Sophie.
Priya: I'll self-assign once my fix is pushed. Sophie please review the snippet behaviour.
Sophie: Will do. If anyone else wants merge window timing: I can be available for merge verification at 16:00 PT.
Alex: We'll aim for 16:00 PT merge window, assuming CI green. If not, we'll hold until tomorrow morning.
docs-bot: Build queued: docs/link-check (after Priya's commit).
Priya: pushed fix — changed snippet + added alias note. CI kicked off.
Ben: :thumbsup: thanks. I'll watch the link-check job and unblock any relative link issues.
Sophie: local snippet tests pass now. re-requesting review on GitHub.
Alex: awesome. tagging reviewers: @Priya + @Sophie. thanks everyone.
Nadia: leaving a quick note for rotation logs — moved PR #8423 to Priya's reviewer slot for today.
Alex: merging plan: if all green by 15:55 PT I'll merge during the 16:00 merge window. If anything flaps, we'll postpone.
Priya: sounds good. back to reviewing other docs now.
Sophie: I added a tiny unit test to snippet_runner that accepts either env var name. keeps CI stable for the transition.
Ben: once merged, can someone follow up to run the site search/update indexing? I can do it if needed.
Alex: @Ben please run the reindex after merge. I'll watch the merge.
docs-bot: Build passed for PR #8423: link-check ✅, snippet-tests ✅. Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/8423
Alex: merging now. thanks all :rocket:
Priya: :tada: great job everyone.
Sophie: nice teamwork.
Ben: closing the coverage gap.
